articles.title: Half of England Is Now a Giant Dust Bowl — And You Might Not Be Able to Water Your Garden!
articles.summary: More than half of England is officially in a drought. Rivers are drying up, and over 20 million people can't use their garden hoses. The Environment Agency says we're using water faster than rain can refill it.

articles.title: Why Democrats Might Stop Talking About 'Saving Democracy' (and What They'll Say Instead)
articles.summary: A new report says Democrats are losing working-class voters because they talk too much about democracy and not enough about paychecks and safety. Researchers say the party needs to listen more and respect voters' values like hard work and patriotism.

articles.title: Dr. Fauci Stays Silent at Senate Hearing — Here's Why He Used the Fifth Amendment
articles.summary: Dr. Anthony Fauci refused to answer questions at a Senate hearing about COVID-19. He used the Fifth Amendment, which lets people stay silent to avoid saying something that could get them in trouble. Republicans accused him of covering up the virus's origins.
